sentence: This project studies how an engineered nanoformulation that targets a cancer protein changes immune proteins and pathways in lung cancer.
This project studies how adenosine switches off T cell signaling in liver cancer and tests drugs that restore that signaling.
This project studies how different forms of one regulator decide the fate of human blood stem cells.
This project studies how epigenetic and environmental factors lower the activity of autism-linked genes in human cerebral organoids.
This project tests a treatment for small cell lung cancer that keeps tumors from avoiding immune attack.
This project builds systems for analyzing genomic information so doctors can tailor medical treatments to each patient.
This project runs early clinical trials of drugs, vaccines and immune modulating treatments to prevent cancer in people at high risk.
This project studies how two human red blood cell factors help the malaria parasite invade red blood cells.
This project supports a center that moves laboratory advances into the diagnosis and treatment of human musculoskeletal disease.
This project studies how the structure of an organelle called the endoplasmic reticulum affects its metabolic function.
This project studies which signaling pathways in the brain support fear memory during sleep, using transgenic mice and human postmortem studies.
This project tests whether plasma transfer can reverse age-related epigenomic changes in microglia and studies microglia in obesity.
This project builds an automated, open-source AI system that screens HIV for drug resistance mutations and picks a therapy in one day.
This project studies how a family of proteins controls signaling by G protein-coupled receptors in the brain.
This project builds a three-dimensional imaging method to map how breast and pancreatic tumors are organized and how cancer cells invade veins.
This project builds deep learning models that help radiologists tell aggressive from indolent prostate cancer on MRI.
This project studies how a genetic regulator helps Klebsiella pneumoniae resist carbapenem antibiotics.
This project studies whether a mutation and overexpression of a histone methyltransferase cause B-cell lymphoma in the same way or different ways.
This project runs a microscopy core that gives vision researchers access to electron and confocal microscopes and image analysis software.
